name: Mauna Kea
description: Fixed highland-volcanic terrain reference point for SRTM extraction.

provenance.dataset_name: NASA Shuttle Radar Topography Mission Global 1 arc second V003 (SRTMGL1.003)
provenance.spatial_resolution: Native 1 arc-second HGT; local spacing 29.090 m east-west, 30.922 m north-south
provenance.temporal_resolution: Static DEM from the SRTM mission
provenance.processing_method: Native complete regional window targeting 9476.05 m physical support; relative elevation is center minus median, slope is a least-squares metric-plane gradient, roughness is plane-residual population standard deviation, and relief is max minus min.

quality.processing_crs: Local metric tangent-plane approximation at site latitude
quality.void_handling: Any NoData sample in the required window rejects all regional metrics; no interpolation.
quality.vertical_datum: Not inferred from HGT bytes; consult the verified SRTMGL1 product documentation for vertical reference.
